title: Modular A/V: Hides theme
description: A barbarian's hall for the Modular A/V dock. Each camera is a picture on a hide, laced into a frame of poles on a wall of dark timber, with war paint in its player's colour. Firelight shows through the hide while its player speaks, the hide goes dark while they're muted, and its thongs are cut when they leave the call. Tally marks under your own name fill with your voice. The header and the voice panel are pieces of hide, the buttons are iron nail heads, and a horned skull hangs on the wall.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player
